# Mohit Kumar — Systems in Motion

> Portfolio of Mohit Kumar, a software engineer in Chandigarh, India. Software Engineer at Rankfirst Technology Pvt. Ltd. since 22 April 2024; Bachelor of Computer Applications, Sri Guru Gobind Singh College, Sector 26, Chandigarh (Panjab University), 2025.

The whole site is a single page with these sections: The Signal (#top), Selected Work (#work), Systems Map (#systems), Experience (#experience), The Lab (#lab), About (#about) and Contact (#contact).

## Selected work

- [BeamTransfer](/#project-beamtransfer): native Android application (Java, XML) for optical file transfer through streaming fountain-coded QR frames, with camera-based reception, file reconstruction, printable QR sheets, document scanning, perspective correction, image filters, batch processing and local history.
- [Ambiora Hotel & Resorts](/#project-ambiora): cinematic hospitality marketing website built with Core PHP, custom routing and views, data-driven content, responsive imagery, JavaScript modules, Motion and Lenis.
- [SGGS ERP](/#project-sggs-erp): Django-based institutional ERP and student-portal integration, including API integration, environment-driven configuration and deployment workflows.
